bootstrap.chain: C stage0 -> Kinal stage1 -> Kinal stage2 -> Kinal stage3

known_c_stage0_differences: Unsafe Alias matching walks rules from oldest to newest instead of latest-first.
PrepareTokens returns only tokens, so Unsafe Alias state is lost and Unit cannot be rejected with Invalid Unit With Unsafe Alias.
Normal and triple Unsafe Alias source/target token-category validation is incomplete.
Parameter scanning does not preserve nested comma depth in every function/local/anonymous-function path.
Validator and AST builder duplicate grammar and can diverge.
Unknown top-level tokens, unknown type members, and some primary-expression failures can be silently advanced or represented as Missing.
Panic-mode synchronization is not equivalent to C stage0.
The C stage0 statement recursion limit of 192 is not implemented.
Meta, Attribute, custom Cast, local-function, package-literal, Block-literal, and anonymous-function scope behavior is only partially converged.
ReadString consumes a character after a backslash at newline or carriage return where C stage0 stops before consuming it.
Unknown-character-to-EOF behavior is shared with C stage0 and must remain locked by differential tests unless both implementations change together.

measurement.lexer_character_comparison_rule: Count numeric comparison operands attached to code/current/next/value/Current(state)/Peek(state); exclude positions, lengths, counters, and token enum encodings.
